query: INSERT INTO businesses.open_cards_time (member_id, at_8am, at_noon, at_5pm, changed_at) SELECT id, $3, $4, $5, $6 FROM businesses.team_member WHERE id = $1 AND business_id = $2 AND removed_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET at_8am = $3, at_noon = $4, at_5pm = $5, changed_at = $6
